claims.sentence: In a separate study, about 39\% of an annotated corpus of 3,063 citations to 100 highly cited biomedical articles contained an accuracy error \citep{sarol2024citationintegrity}.
claims.claim: The study annotated 3,063 citations to 100 highly cited biomedical articles, and about 39% of them had an accuracy error.
claims.excerpt: We manually annotated 100 highly-cited biomedical publications (reference articles) and citations to them. ... A total of 3063 citation instances were annotated (39.18% with accuracy errors).
claims.location: p. 1, Abstract (Results); cf. Section 3.1 and Table 1 (Total errors 1200 of 3063, 39.18%, comprising 18.02% major and 21.16% minor)
